༄༅/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i bsdus don bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i bsdus don bzhugs so/ /

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rang sangs rgyas dang 'phags pa nyan thos thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dran pa nyer bar bzhag pa'i don snang bar byed pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa 'di la gsum ste/ rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i klad don dang*/ gzhung gi don dang*/ mthar phyin pa'i bya ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshan brjod pa dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba'o/ /gzhung gi don la gnyis ste/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ ston pa gang gis/ gnas gang du/ dus gang gi tshe/ dgos pa gang gi phyir/ chos gang bstan pa dang*/ ma rtogs pa sems can gyi gzhi ngos bzung ba dang*/ gnyen po go rim dang bcas pa dang*/ de'i rgyu 'bras rnam dbye'o/ /de la lnga ste/ zag bcas zag med spyir bstan pa dang*/ las nag po'i rgyu 'bras dang*/ chos thams cad kyi rgyu 'bras dang*/ dpe bkod pa gdams dang bcas pa'o/ /nag po bstan pa la bzhi ste/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ rtsa ba'i rgyu rkyen dang*/ rnam dbye rgyas bshad dang*/ 'bras bu bshad pa'o/ /rnam dbye la brgyad de/ ngo bo/ yul gyi rnam dbye/ dus/ rkyen kun slong gi rnam dbye dgu bstan pa/ sdig par mi 'gyur ba lnga ngos bzungabs srog gcod dang*/ ngo bo/ len lugs kyi dbye ba/ gzhan dbye ba dgu shugs la bstan pas ma byin pa dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye bas 'dod log dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye bas rdzun dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye bas phra ma dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye bas tshig rtsub dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba/ bdun po'i lci yang gis/ ngag 'khyal dang*/ brnab sems/ gnod sems log lta'i ngo bo/ dbye bas rnams dang bcas pa'o/ /'bras bu la gnyis te/ rgyu mthun/ rnam smin/ dbang 'bras/ skye bu byed pa/ bral 'bras ngos bzung ba dang*/ las kyi mu bzhi bstan pa'o/ /dkar ba'i rgyu 'bras la drug ste/ ngo bo brjod pa dang*/ rnam dbye dang*/ dge bcu so so'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu dang*/ 'bras bu gzhan snga ma dang sbyar ba dang*/

chung 'bring chen po'i go rims dang*/ zhar la zag med dang mtshungs ldan bstan pa'o/ chos thams cad kyi rgyu 'bras la bdun te/ dge mi dge 'dod khams kyi rgyur bstan/ gzugs khams dang gzugs med kyi rgyu sems pas phyi rol du rtog pa dang*/ phyi nang bar gsum gyi khams bco brgyad la rtog pa dang*/ khams kyi rkyen gyis tshor ba la sems dpa' dang*/ 'dus te reg pa la rtogs pa dang*/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa la rtogs pa dang*/ 'jig rten la 'da' bar byed pa'i chos la rtog pas so/ /de la bzhi ste/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi yan lag la rtog pa dang*/ rtsa ba mthong ba dang*/ phung po lnga'i ngo bo dang*/ phung po dang rten 'brel gyi byed las so/ /dpe bkod pa phan yon dang bcas pa la lnga ste/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ rgyas bshad dang*/ las 'brel ba'i don dang*/ nyon mongs dang 'brel pa spang ba dang*/ gnyen po dang 'brel ba bsten pa'o/ /rgyas par bshad pa la dgu ste/ dmyal ba dang*/ yi dwags dang dud 'gro/ klu lha min dang bcas pa dang*/ mi dang 'dod khams kyi lha dang*/ gzugs khams dang*/ gzugs med pa'i khams dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams dang*/ bar do'i khams lus dang 'brel tshul lam dang bcas pa bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dmyal ba'i rigs gsum mdor bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu tsha dmyal brgyad spyir bstan pa dang*/ rgyas bshad do/ /de la bcu gcig ste/ gtso bo'i rgyu 'bras/ 'khor bcu drug gi ming*/ 'khor bcu drug gi rgyu/ gtso bo'o/ 'khor rnams kyi rnam smin dang dbang 'bras/ srid pa gzhan gyi rgyu mthun/ tshe tshad drug gis yang sos bshad pa dang*/ gtso bo'i rgyu 'bras/ 'khor bcu drug ming*/ rgyu'i las/ rnam smin dang dbang 'bras/ srid pa gzhan gyi rgyu mthun/ tshe tshad drug gis thig nag dang*/ gtso bo'o/ 'khor gyi ming*/ rgyu'i las gtso 'khor gyi sdug bsngal/ srid pa gzhan gyi rgyu mthun/ tshe tshad dang drug gis bsdus gzhom dang*/

gtso bo'i rgyu 'bras/ 'khor gyi ming*/ rgyu'i las/ gtso 'khor gyi rnam smin/ gshin rjes chang gis nyes pa brjod pa/ srid pa gzhan gyi rgyu mthun/ tshe tshad dang bdun gyis ngu 'bod dang*/ gtso bo/ 'khor gyi ming*/ / gtso 'khor gyi rgyu 'bras/ srid pa gzhan gyi rgyu mthun/ tshe tshad dang lnga'i ngu 'bod chen po dang*/ gtso bo'i rgyu/ 'khor gyi ming*/ shin tu sdug bsngal ba/ 'khor gyi rgyu 'bras bshad pa/ srid pa gzhan gyi rgyu mthun/ tshe tshad drug gis tsha ba'i dmyal ba dang*/ gtso bo'o/ /'khor gyi ming*/ gtso bo'i sdug bsngal/ 'khor gyi rgyu 'bras/ tshe tshad dang lnga yis rab tu tsha ba dang*/ mdor bstan gnad gcod gyi sdug bsngal/ bar do'i sdug bsngal/ gtso bo'i sdug bsngal 'khor gyi ming*/ rgyu 'bras/ tshe tshad/ chos spangs ba'i sngug bsngal de la bzlog par gdams pa dang bcu yis mnar med dang*/ ming*/ rgyu/ gnas/ tshe tshad dang bzhis grang dmyal dang*/ gnas/ las/ sdug bsngal dang gsum gyis nye tshe ba dang*/ skye gnas kyi don bsdu ba'o/ yi dwags la brgyad de/ mdor bstan dang*/ gnas dang*/ gshin rje'i rgyal po dang*/ rigs sum cu so drug gis mdor bstan dang*/ rgyu 'bras rgyas bshad dang*/ skye gnas dang*/ srid pa gzhan gyi rgyu mthun dang*/ srid pa'i byed las dpe dang bcas pa'o/ /rgyu 'bras rgyas bshad la sum cu so drug ste/ ldog gu/ kha khab 'dra/ skyugs pa za/ bshang za/ bsam mtsho/ zas kyi dri za/ chos za/ chu 'thung*/ kun ston no/ mchil ma za/ 'phreng ba za/ khrag za/ sha za/ gdug pa za/ drag shul spyod/ glag lta/ sa 'og gnas/ rdzu 'phrul chen po/ lus 'bar/ byis pa glags lta/ 'dod gzugs can/ gling bar gnas/ gshin rje'i chad pa/ byil pa za/ mdangs za/ tshangs pa'i srin bu/ me za/ mi gtsang za/ rlung za/ me mdag za/ dug za/ dgon par gnas/ dur khrod gnas/ shing la gnas/ gzhi mdor gnas/ bdud rigs yi dwags so/ /dud 'gro la gnyis te/

mdor bstan dang/ rgyas bshad do/ /de la gsum ste/ kha 'thor dang*/ klu dang*/ lha min no/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ dmyal bar gnas pa dang*/ spyir bstan/ sa bsrungs kyi bu'i las gnyis kyis lha'i dud 'gro dang*/ spyir bstan/ skye gnas/ nyon mongs dang ldan tshul/ zas bzhi bshad pa dang*/ bzhis mi yul gyi dud 'gro dang*/ dud 'gro spyi'i mi dge ba shas gang che bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa klu la bdun ste/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ dkar po dang*/ nag po'i gtso bo dang*/ gnas zas 'khor spyi'i grangs dang*/ gzhan yang bshad pa dang*/ tshe tshad do/ /gsum pa lha ma yin la gsum ste/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ rgyas bshad dang*/ 'thab pa'i tshul lo/ /bar pa la bzhi ste/ gnas kyi bkod pa/ gtso bo'i rgyu 'bras/ 'khor gyi rgyu 'bras/ tshe tshad/ nyi zla ba'i tshul dang*/ lnga sgra gcan bshad pa dang*/ gnas/ gtso bo'i rgyu 'bras/ 'khor gyi rgyu 'bras/ tshe tshad bzhi yis brtan pa bshad pa dang*/ gnas/ gtso bo'i rgyu 'bras/ 'khor gyi rgyu 'bras/ tshe tshad dang bzhis rtser gnas bshad pa dang*/ gnas/ gtso 'khor gyi rgyu 'bras/ tshe tshad srid pa gzhan gyi rgyu mthun dang*/ bzhis gser ldan bshad pa'o/ /lha dang lha ma yin 'thab pa la drug ste/ rgyu gnyis bshad pa dang*/ rim bzhin 'thab pa'i tshul dang*/ thag bzangs ris chas pa dang*/ lha dbang glang po dang bcas te chas pa dang*/ 'das 'byung pa dang*/ g.yul 'gyed tshul lo/ /de la bdun te/ g.yul ji ltar 'gyed pa'i rim pa/ 'thab tshul dngos/ gtso bo'i gnyis/ thabs pa'i tshul/ g.yul gyi rnam grangs/ sa bsrungs kyi bu'i stobs/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi tshul/ so sor 'gro ba'i tshul lo/ mi'i le'u la bcu gnyis te/ mtshams sbyor dang*/ mchog dman dang*/ gnas dang*/ lus tshad dang*/ tshe tshad dang*/ longs spyod dang*/ rigs kyi dbye ba dang*/ 'dzam gling du skyes pa'i ma mtha' dang*/ mchog 'khor los bsgyur ba dang*/ 'bras bu'i rnam dbye dang*/ gnod byed dang*/

gling gzhan yang bstan pa'o/ /'dod khams kyi lha'i le'u la gnyis ste/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ de la drug te/ rgyal chen bzhi'i lha/ sum cu rtsa gsum/ 'thab bral/ dga' ldan/ 'phrul dga'/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed do/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ ri rab ri bdun mtsho dang bcas pas gnas bshad pa dang*/ mdor bstan dang*/ skye ba'i rgyu mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do/ /de la bzhi ste/ phreng thogs dang*/ yol thogs dang*/ rtag myos dang*/ pi wang can gsum pa'o/ /re re la gnas gzhan bcu bcu ste/ bzhi bcu las/ dang po bcu ni/ zur na gnas/ mtha' la gnas/ 'bras bu nyer 'tsho/ dkar po spyod/ thams cad dgar gnas 'gro mgyogs yul la chags/ 'dod la chags yid g.yo/ nye ba'i tshal dang*/ bcu po'i rgyu dang*/ spyi'i longs spyod/ skye tshul lo/ /gnyis pa yol thogs la gsum ste/ ming dang*/ rgyu dang*/ longs spyod do/ / gsum pa rtag myos la gsum ste/ mdor bstan dang*/ lhag dga' ud dpal mdog /pad dkar spyod/ dmar po spyod/ sna tshogs gnas mthor spyod/ rgun chang*/ rtag myos/ yul la 'dod/ chu bsil gnas/ brtan dga' dang bcu po rgyu dang bcas pa dang*/ spyi'i longs spyod do/ /bzhi pa pi wang can gsum pa la bzhi ste/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ dris dga'/ sgra snyan/ bde la chags/ skyor chus skyes/ lus dkar/ phan tshun dga'/ yang dag chags spyod/ 'khor dang rnams spyod/ dkyil krungs bcas skye/ spyod ldan dang bcu po'i rgyu 'bras rgyas bshad dang*/ rgyal po bzhi'i gnas dang*/ kun tu rgyu ba'i lha bshad pa'o/ /de la lnga ste/ skar ma'i grangs/ nyi zla'i bkod pa/ zhor la zla ba 'phel 'grib gyi nges pa/ bye brag gi rgyu/ tshe tshad rgyu mthun dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa sum cu rtsa gsum la lnga ste/ mtshams sbyor/ brgya sbyin gyi rgyu 'bras/ gnas kyi khyad par/ so so'i rgyas bshad spyi'i longs spyod bshad pa'o/ / rgyas bshad pa la sum cu so gsum ste/

chos bzang*/ mthor bar gnas/ ri rtser gnas/ blta na sdug /phyogs gcig gnas/ shing gseb gnas/ shing rta sna tshogs/ dga' bar gnas/ rnam mdzes/ yongs 'du'i tshal/ 'dres pa'i 'gram/ tshang tshing 'gram/ nor bu'i snying po/ kun tu gsal spyod/ gser phuga'aphreng ba'i grib ma/ mthon dman rgyu/ sna tshogs bkra bas phye ba/ sbyor ba 'jug pa/ zhib spyod/ glu sgra shin tu chags pa'i gnas/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang chos ston pa'i bkod pa dang bcas pa gzi brjid 'bar/ zla ba'i gnas ltar rgyu ba/ sa la zung sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa dang bcas pa/ mig phyed btsums kyis 'gro ba/ lus mdog bzang zhing che ba/ nor bu 'chang gnas/ rigs mthun pa 'khor na gnas/ 'thor spyod/ gzi brjid 'phreng ba 'bar/ ma 'dres pa'o/ /spyi'i longs spyod bshad pa la dgu ste/ phyogs kyi dbye ba/ gnod sbyin gyi gnas rnga bo che/ kun dga'i tshal/ skye ba'i tshul/ longs spyod rgyas bshad/ las rjes su 'breng ba'i tshul/ srid pa gzhan gyi rgyu mthun/ tshe tshad do/ /gsum pa 'thab bral la bcu gnyis ste/ spyir bstan/ gtso bo'i rgyu 'bras/ spyi'i rgyu'i las/ gnas gzhan gyi ming*/ longs spyod kyi khyad par/ skye ba'i tshul/ bde ba myong ba'i tshul/ bya rnams kyi skad/ mchod rten gyi bkod pa/ 'chi ba'i tshul/ bskul ba/ tshe tshad do/ /bzhi pa dga' ldan bshad pa la bzhi ste/ spyir bstan/ dbye ba/ thun mongs gi rgyu bshad pa/ longs spyod rgyas bshad do/ /de la bcu bdun ste/ sa gzhi 'bab chu/ ri dang ljon shing*/ gos dang rgyan/ bza' btung*/ rdzing bu/ me tog / bya khang bzang*/ lha mo'i 'khor/ gzhon pa/ chos kyi dga' ston/ skye ba'i rgyu gzhan bstan pa/ bag yod la gdams pa/ 'chi ba'i tshul/ srid pa gzhan gyi rgyu mthun/ tshe tshad bstan pa'o/ /lnga pa 'phrul dga' bstan pa la brgyad de/ rgyu spyir bstan/ gtso bo'i rgyu 'bras/ 'phrul dga'i don bshad pa/ longs spyod kyi khyad par/

chos kyi dga' ston/ 'pho ba'i tshul/ srid pa gzhan gyi rgyu mthun/ tshe tshad do/ /drug pa gzhan 'phrul dbang byed la lnga ste/ spyir bstan/ skye ba'i rgyu/ rnam dbye/ bdud rigs kyi gtso bo'i rgyu 'bras gtam rgyud dang bcas pa/ longs spyod khyad 'phags bshad pa'o/ /de la bcu gnyis te/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi don/ gzhal med khang*/ mda' lnga'i don/ lha mo'i tshul/ sil snyan la sogs pa'i longs spyod/ me tog /sa phyogs kyi khyad par/ de la chags na bdud nyid du 'gyur ba'i tshul/ ma chags pa'i yon tan/ rgyu la gdams pa/ tshe tshad/ rgyu 'bras gzhan rgyas bshad do/ /de la bdun te/ nyin mtshan gyi khyad par/ lus tshad/ mi dge ba bdun spangs ba'i 'bras bu/ sbyin pa so so'i 'bras bu/ sbyin gnas lnga'i dbye ba/ mchog dman gyi dbye ba/ bsam pa'i khyad par bstan pa'o/ /gzugs khams la gsum ste/ khams gong ma'i don dang*/ rnam dbye spyir bstan pa dang*/ so sor bshad pa'o/ /de la lnga ste/ bsam gtan dang po'i rgyu/ chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po'i 'bras bu/ bsam gtan gyis rigs gsum bshad/ zhing khams/ gzhal med khang gi yon tan/ spyod pa dang bral ba'i longs spyod/ skye ba'i tshul yon tan/ gtso bo'i bshad pa dang dgu yis bsam gtan dang po'i gnas gzhan gsum bshad pa dang*/ rgyu/ chung 'bring chen po'i dbye ba/ 'og ma las khyad par 'phags pa gsum gyis bsam gtan gnyis pa'i lha gnas gsum bshad pa dang*/ rgyu chung 'bring chen po'i dbye ba/ yon tan gyi khyad par dang gsum gyis bsam gtan gsum pa'i lha gnas gsum bshad pa dang*/ rgyu/ chung 'bring chen po'i dbye ba/ khyad par dang gsum gyis bsam gtan bzhi pa'i gnas gzhan gsum bshad pa dang*/ zag bcas dang zag med kyis zin pa'i rnam dbye gtsang ma rigs lnga dang bcas pa'o/ /de la bcu gnyis te/ byis pa nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan thob kyang ldog pa'i tshul/ don rab 'byed pa bsngags pa/

de nyid kyis bsam gtan bzhi bshad pa/ zhar la de bzhin nyid kyi bsam gtan bshad pa/ bsam gtan nyon mongs can dang nyon mongs med pa'i rnam dbye/ shes rab kyis ma zin pa'i bsam gtan bzhi pa la 'du shes bkag nas bsgoms pas lha tshe ring por 'gro ba'i tshul/ shes rab kyis zin pas gtsang ma rigs lngar 'gro tshul/ de dag gi gtso bo/ spyi'i don/ lus kyi tshad/ tshe tshad/ tha gru'i tshad bstan pa'o/ /gzugs med pa'i khams la bcu ste/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ bsten pa dang*/ dmigs pa/ khyad par dang gsum gyis nam mkha' mtha' yas dang*/ bzhi ga'i nyer bdogs dang*/ rnam shes mtha' yas dang*/ ci yang med pa dang*/ 'du shes med 'du shes min dang*/ kun gzhi nyon yid gnas pa'i tshul dang*/ gnas gang du ngo bo gang thob pa dang*/ tshe tshad dang*/ shes rab kyis ma zin pa'i skyon dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul bshad pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams bshad pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la bzhi ste/ rlung*/ chu/ gser/ de dag gi 'khor yug / rkyen/ ri gling mtsho/ de rnams kyi tshad/ gling bzhi'i tshad dang dbyibs/ dus ci tsam gyis chags pa dang dgu yis 'jig rten gyi khams chags tshul bshad pa dang*/ dmyal ba la sogs pa'i gnas gzhan rnams zhor la bstan pa dang*/ brtan g.yo ltar snang ba'i rgyu rkyen/ kha dog dang dbyibs kyi khams/ de gzugs yin pa/ sgra dang*/ dri ro dang*/ reg bya dang*/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam rig gi dbye ba dang*/ bdun gyi yul dang 'brel ba bshad pa dang*/ rnam grangs gzhan bshad pa'o/ /de la dgu ste/ zhor la ming gzhi bstan pa dang*/ bskal chung gi grangs dang*/ snod bcud 'jig pa'i tshul dang*/ rgyu'i nges pa dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i chags 'jig dang*/ rang snang yin pa'i tshul dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don dang*/ dag pa'i zhing khams bstan pa dang*/ bka' dang bstan chos rnams la sbyar ba'o/

/ bar do dang khams lus dang 'brel tshul/ lam dang bcas pa bstan pa la lnga ste/ nang du rtog pa mdor bstan/ skye 'chi'i tshul bshad pa/ sems can gyi gnas bshad pa/ bar do bshad pa/ yang dag pa'i lam bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ khams gsum 'du byed pa dang*/ skye rgas 'chi ba'i ngo bo dang*/ 'chi tshul rgyas bshad do/ /gsum pa la bzhi ste/ khams kyi don dang*/ sems can gyi gnas pa bdun dang*/ gnas bzhi bshad pa dang*/ mu bzhir 'gyur tshul lo/ / bzhi pa la bcu gsum ste/ bar do mtshams sbyor byed dang*/ bar do'i lus kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ 'dren byed rgyas bshad dang*/ bar do'i lus rigs drug gang du 'gro ba'i kha dog dang*/ dbyibs dang*/ dus dang*/ mgo gang du bstan pa dang*/ gos yod med dang*/ srid pa'i nges pa dang*/ mngal du 'jug kha'i snang ba dang*/ zhugs dus kyi snang ba dang*/ shes bzhin dang ldan mi ldan dang*/ don bsdu ba'o/ / lnga pa la bdun te/ lam gyi gzhi rten 'brel mthong ba dang*/ bdag lta spong ba dang*/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rig pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug bsgrub pa dang*/ snying rje chen po mthong ba dang*/ lam sbyang pa dang*/ byang chub chen po thob par bstan pa'o/ /rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba la lnga ste/ rgyal ba'i yon tan la gus pa bskyed pa dang*/ brtsams pa don dang ldan mi ldan brjod pa dang*/ bsngo ba smon lam dang bcas pa dang*/ ji ltar du bsdus pa dang*/ bzod gsol tshigs bcad do/ /dam pa'i chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i don snang bar byed pa'i bstan chos kyi bsdus don rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba rdzogs so//
// mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ karma pa rang byung rdo rje'i gsung*/ dam pa'i chos dran pa nyer bzhag gi bsdus don/ - PAGE 10 -- PAGE 11 -- PAGE 1 -
